Experienced Freelance Project Architect / Senior Architectural Designer
Remote Work | NYC Projects | Flexible Schedule | Immediate Start
Kohn Architecture, a small, established, design-oriented architecture firm located in Union Square, New York City, is seeking an experienced Freelance Project Architect or Senior Architectural Designer with 10+ years of professional experience.
Our practice encompasses a diverse range of interesting residential and commercial projects, including high-end apartment renovations, restaurants, commercial interiors, and building conversions. We are currently looking for assistance with two substantial residential apartment renovation projects, with opportunities for additional work on future projects.
We are looking for a talented, self-motivated professional who can take our designs and develop them into complete, well-coordinated DOB filing and construction document sets with minimal supervision.
Qualifications
Minimum 10 years of architectural experience, preferably working on NYC projects.
Excellent AutoCAD skills, including Xrefs, layers, and drawing organization.
Proven ability to independently prepare complete construction document and DOB filing sets.
Strong knowledge of construction detailing and documentation.
Familiarity with NYC Building Codes, zoning regulations, and DOB filing requirements is a significant plus.
Ability to work within our established office drawing standards.
Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Bluebeam or Adobe Acrobat. SketchUp experience is a plus.
What We Offer
Remote work with flexible scheduling.
Interesting, design-oriented projects with a variety of architectural challenges.
The independence to manage your own work without excessive oversight.
A collaborative, informal working relationship with a small architectural practice.
Opportunities for ongoing freelance assignments.
Potential transition to a full-time position as the firm grows.
Candidates must have their own licensed AutoCAD software and be comfortable working remotely.
Compensation: Competitive and negotiable based on experience and qualifications. Hourly or project-based arrangements are available.
Start Date: Immediate.
How to Apply
Please email your resume only to:
Website: www.kohnarchitecture.nyc
Please do not send large portfolio files. Our email system cannot accept attachments exceeding 8 MB. Portfolios or representative work samples will be requested from selected candidates.
